heading.en: The Lamanites come against the people of God—The Anti-Nephi-Lehies rejoice in Christ and are visited by angels—They choose to suffer death rather than to defend themselves—More Lamanites are converted. About 90–77 B.C.
heading.sm: Ua o mai sa Lamanā e faasagatau i tagata o le Atua—Ua olioli sa Aneti-Nifae-Liae ia Keriso ma ua asiasi mai agelu ia te i latou—Ua latou filifili e mafatia i le oti nai lo le puipuia o i latou lava—Ua liua isi sa Lamanā e toatele. E tusa o le 90–77 T.L.M.
